security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan RTL, SPMP and PMP/PMA checks execute in parallel within the load/store unit (LSU) and instruction fetch unit (IFU). The spec mandates 'SPMP exceptions take priority over PMP or PMA exceptions.' If the hardware exception aggregation module (e.g., exception priority encoder, trap cause MUX) selects the PMP/PMA access-fault exception code over the SPMP page-fault exception code when both checkers simultaneously flag a violation for the same memory access, the SPMP violation is masked. This occurs specifically when: (a) the PMP fault signal arrives at the exception priority encoder one cycle before the SPMP fault signal due to combinational path depth differences; (b) the fixed-priority exception encoder assigns a higher priority to PMP access-fault exceptions (code 1/5/7) than to SPMP-induced page-fault exceptions (code 12/13/15); or (c) the combined exception reporting MUX selects the first-arriving fault signal rather than enforcing SPMP-over-PMP precedence.
security_spec.summary: SPMP violations must override PMP/PMA violations in the hardware exception priority encoder; incorrect priority ordering silently converts SPMP page faults into PMP access faults, enabling privilege escape where S-mode interprets a PMP trap as unrelated rather than an SPMP isolation breach
